lines: I could draw the route back with my eyes closed. I would rather not walk it again tonight.
For a moment, every direction looked wrong. Then home looked possible again.
I know the way home on paper. Knowing it while scared is different.
Every landmark looked strange in the dark. Then the village lights found me.
I would mark that route in red if I ever had to draw it.
The map says the road is short. My feet disagree.
I came back with no new map, only a better respect for old paths.
For once, I was glad the village was exactly where I left it.
When danger came close, nobody had time to sound brave first.
You learn a lot about a village when everyone hears the bell at once.
